class.name: SlangMaterialImporter
class.description: Enables importing materials written in Slang. A [code].slang[/code] file with an entry-point marked [code][gd::Material][/code] is compiled to Godot shading language and imported as a plain [Shader], which can be assigned to the [member ShaderMaterial.shader] of any [ShaderMaterial]. A file is imported as either a material or a [SlangShaderFile], never both. [SlangShaderImporter] is the default for [code].slang[/code] files; pick [code]Slang Material[/code] under [b]Import As[/b] in the Import dock to use this one instead.
